dedupe_keys.name: dhaka north city corporation ward level waste collection trips workers and vehicles 2017 to 2019

description: This dataset describes solid waste collection in the wards of Dhaka North City Corporation, Bangladesh, and was built to test whether wards whose collection was contracted out to private firms collected more waste than wards served by the city itself. It was deposited on Mendeley Data in February 2022 by Ahmed Adib. The main series give monthly waste collected in tonnes, number of trips and number of workers per ward from January 2017 to December 2019, from weighbridge records of secondary waste delivered from secondary transfer stations to the landfill. Further data from the city's waste management department and the contractors give vehicles by type and capacity and allotted fuel and trips, with annual variables that may influence collection; raw data, corrections and the author's calculations are included. Data were obtained through formal applications. The files are free to download under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Coverage is the wards of Dhaka North. Caveats: only secondary collection is measured, 2020 was left out because of COVID-19 disruption, and earlier monthly data were unavailable. Simulation uses: observed collection volumes, fleet and staffing by ward to calibrate collection capacity and service models for a megacity. Related records: the synthetic Dhaka smart waste IoT dataset (data-a-one-year-context-aware-synthetic-iot-dataset-for-smart-waste-management-in-dhaka-bangladesh-43-8-million-hou-p02949) simulates bin-level data for the same city.
